queries.query: SELECT mean("usage_system") AS "system", mean("usage_user") AS "user", mean("usage_idle") AS "idle" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."cpu" WHERE "host" = :host: AND time > :dashboardTime: AND "cpu" = 'cpu-total' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
queries.label: CPU Usage

queries.query: SELECT mean("used_percent") AS "last_used_percent" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."mem" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND "host"=:host: GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(previous)
queries.label: Memory Usage

detailQueries.query: SELECT mean("used_percent") AS "used_percent" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."mem" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: memory-usage

detailQueries.query: SELECT mean("free")/1073741824 AS "free", mean("cached")/1073741824 AS "cached", mean("buffered")/1073741824 AS "buffers", mean("used")/1073741824 AS "used" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."mem" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: memory-used

detailQueries.query: SELECT mean("available")/1073741824 AS "available" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."mem" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: memory-available

detailQueries.query: SELECT mean("sreclaimable")/1073741824 AS "sreclaimable" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."mem" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: memory-sreclaimable

detailQueries.label: memory-sunreclaim

detailQueries.label: memory-slab

detailQueries.query: SELECT (mean("swap_total") - mean("swap_free")) / mean("swap_total") * 100 AS "swap_used_percent" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."mem" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: memory-swap-percent

detailQueries.query: SELECT (mean("swap_total") - mean("swap_free"))/1073741824 AS "swap_used" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."mem" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: AND "host"=':host:' GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)
detailQueries.label: memory-swap-used

queries.query: SELECT last("total")/1073741824 AS "total_gib", last("used")/1073741824 AS "used_gib", last("free")/1073741824 AS "free_gib", last("used_percent") AS "used_percent", last("inodes_used_percent") AS "inode_used_percent" FROM ":db:".":rp:"."disk" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND "host"=:host: GROUP BY "path"
queries.label: Disk Usage
